tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the porcelain ground every screen sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, answer options, the lesson canvas.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, idle borders of options and inputs. Decorative only; never the sole marker of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (inputs, secondary buttons). 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and Dutch lesson text, on surface, surface-raised and delft-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: English translations, hints, metadata, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: delft
tokens.usage: The brand blue: primary actions, links, glazed tile motifs, active states. As text, on surface, surface-raised or delft-soft.

tokens.name: delft-deep
tokens.usage: Press shadow under delft buttons and the fully glazed (Mastered) tile ground.

tokens.name: delft-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind delft text: selected option, saved-word chip, info notes.

tokens.name: on-delft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a delft or delft-deep fill.

tokens.name: biscuit
tokens.usage: Unglazed clay: locked and unstarted theme tiles, empty corner motifs. Warm on purpose against the cool porcelain.

tokens.name: biscuit-line
tokens.usage: Outline of an empty corner motif on a biscuit tile.

tokens.name: oranje
tokens.usage: Reward moments only: XP, weekly-goal ring, perfect-run burst. Never for actions or errors.

tokens.name: on-oranje
tokens.usage: Text on an oranje fill (XP pill).

tokens.name: oranje-text
tokens.usage: Reward numbers as text (+12 XP) on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Correct-answer border, icon and label, on surface-raised or correct-soft. Always paired with a check icon and the word Goed.

tokens.name: correct-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the correct feedback sheet and correct option.

tokens.name: incorrect
tokens.usage: Wrong-answer border, icon and label, on surface-raised or incorrect-soft. Always paired with a cross icon and the words Niet helemaal.

tokens.name: incorrect-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the incorrect feedback sheet and wrong option.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. Alias of delft.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Results screen headline, one per screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles and theme names on the theme page.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Numbers that matter: XP, days this week, words due.

styles.name: lesson-text
styles.usage: Dutch sentences learners read and tap. Large on purpose: every letter matters.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tap a word to see what it means.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above titles; never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips and pills; between answer options.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between sections in a lesson.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of results screen, hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Theme tiles: nearly square, like a real fired tile.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, word tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, answer options, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners only).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: XP pill, progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Under primary buttons. Pressing moves the button down 4px and removes it: a physical, tile-like click.

tokens.name: shadow-press-neutral
tokens.usage: Under secondary buttons, answer options and word tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Feedback sheet rising from the bottom.
